ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
cairo:
- '1'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge,conda-forge/label/python_rc
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
expat:
- '2'
freetype:
- '2'
glib:
- '2'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.15.* *_cp315
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - python
  - channel_sources
zlib:
- '1'
name: mplcairo
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: mplcairo
  version: "0.6.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/mplcairo-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: eac1d408cf4101db0ab4d0d57e6c3840bd5434818dc6cd295fc923062f9180d5

build:
  number: 5
  skip: win
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pybind11 >=2.8.0
        - cairo
        - pycairo >=1.16.0
        - expat
        - freetype
        - glib
        - zlib
        - if: linux
          then: xorg-xorgproto
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - pkg-config
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >=62
    - setuptools-scm >=6.2
    - pybind11 >=2.8.0
    - cairo
    - pycairo >=1.16.0
    - pip
    # the following are needed to find cairo with pkg-config
    - expat
    - freetype
    - glib
    - zlib
    - if: linux
      then: xorg-xorgproto
  run:
    - python
    - matplotlib-base >=2.2
    - pillow
    - cairo
    - pycairo >=1.16.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - mplcairo
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: A (new) cairo backend for Matplotlib.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/matplotlib/mplcairo
  repository: https://github.com/matplotlib/mplcairo
  documentation: https://github.com/matplotlib/mplcairo/blob/main/README.rst

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - andrewdnolan
    - xylar
